text:
Maya Chen: Quick UX check - users think "rotate" always kills the old key because of the red banner. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/rotate-ux
Samir Patel: Yeah, ambiguous. Suggest changing the banner behavior: only show danger-level UI when the user chooses to revoke the old key.
Jamie Ortiz: Accessibility: add aria-live for the danger text and ensure focus movement announces it. When the revoke option is toggled on, the alert should be read by screen readers.
Kevin Liu: Backend: we can support a revoke_old_key boolean on the rotate API. Default false. We'll feature-flag it and add server-side validation for critical orgs.
Maya Chen: Proposed microcopy for the checkbox: "Also revoke existing key after rotation (recommended if key may be compromised)". Default unchecked. When checked show inline red summary: "Old key will be revoked and stop working immediately."
Samir Patel: UX flow: primary "Rotate" CTA stays neutral unless revoke checked -> then CTA becomes danger-colored and we require a small confirmation modal explaining outage risk.
Jamie Ortiz: Keyboard rules: modal opens -> focus on first input, tab to checkbox. If checkbox checked, insert small focusable summary that is announced via aria-live. Escape returns focus to the original key row.
Maya Chen: Can ops-bot open a ticket with copy + accessibility + api flag work?
ops-bot: Created PROD-1522: "Rotate flow: revoke toggle + accessible alerts + copy updates" assigned to @Jamie, @Kevin, @Samir. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-1522
Kevin Liu: I'll add the flag behind a feature toggle and link PR to PROD-1522.
Maya Chen: Thanks all; Jamie please push updated Figma before EOD so we can lock acceptance criteria in tomorrow's sync. :thumbsup:
